description: Work in progress. From a topological_offset construction (a .vtu, or a .msh with corr_input_vid), thins the offset band around the solid to a target thickness and, with prism_dominant, rebuilds it as prisms, pyramids and tets.

rod_mode.description: Build rods from original-correspondence offset regions collapsed to vertex rings. Equalize degrees along each path and map matching transported material slots. Construct adjacent-ring prism layers atomically, swap exterior interfaces when needed, and connect retained background through pyramids. Preserve input volume, shell reconstruction and protected attachment stars; invalid layers retain tets. Requires explicit input labels and correspondence.

rod_radius.description: Rod mode only. Absolute target section radius; positive, or zero to use thicknessratio times the mean centerline edge length. Infeasible circular targets retain valid geometry and are reported.

input.description: Construction .vtu or Gmsh 4.1 .msh with corr_input_vid. MSH can derive labels and cell tags from the tag_0/offset/ambient physical groups; explicit PRISM fields are also supported.

output.description: Output .vtu or .msh (Gmsh 4.1 ASCII) filename, relative to the JSON directory. A missing extension becomes .vtu.

input_dir.description: Base directory for input; set by wmtk_app to the JSON directory.

thicknessratio.description: Positive target thickness relative to the mean length of unique input surface edges.

iterations.description: Number of construction collapse/target-smoothing iterations. Zero computes targets without this construction optimization stage; quality_improvement has independent cycle and smoothing settings.

keep_background_mesh.description: Keep exterior background tetrahedra during optimization/output. Background must remain strictly positive. Without background_remeshing only offset vertices move. Targets are computed from the band alone.

ignore_background_mesh.description: Explicitly discard background tetrahedra before rod preprocessing and joint optimization. Keep input volume and offset band, remove background constraints and background-pyramid reconstruction, and do not reattach the discarded mesh. Overrides keep_background_mesh. Intended for a band-only result or a background-constraint comparison.

prism_dominant.description: After optimization, reconstruct conforming prisms, input-apex shell pyramids and tetrahedra. Retained background receives kernel-point pyramids in feasible disjoint quad-diagonal edge-star cavities. Preserve existing points, input volume and non-cavity background; fall back to conforming tet regions on failed geometry, overlap or search limits.

export_input_and_shell.description: Additionally export the union of input volume and offset band as <output_stem>_input_shell.msh and .vtu, using the same final coordinates, hybrid cells and attributes while omitting background cells.

min_tet_volume.description: Optional nonnegative signed-volume floor for new or modified shell tetrahedra, candidate pyramid decompositions and new background pyramid cavity cones. The default zero requires strictly positive volume using exact predicates, without a coordinate-scale-dependent cutoff. Background optimization and unchanged background tets also require strictly positive volume.

smoothing_max_backtracks.description: Maximum smoothing step halvings after the full target step; between 0 and 60.

jacobian_smoothing_iterations.description: Optional prism Jacobian smoothing rounds after tet optimization. Zero disables this stage. Only offset vertices move; input, correspondence and connectivity remain fixed.

relative_tet_volume_floor.description: Optional fraction in [0,1). Each collapse or smoothing move must retain more than this fraction of every modified surviving tet's volume, including background. Zero keeps the original strict-positive rule. Deleted collapse cells are excluded. The absolute band min_tet_volume floor still applies.

transition_smoothing_iterations.description: Optional local convex-envelope initialization and concave-hinge smoothing after hybrid construction, in [0,100]. Only outer offset vertices in protected/marked transition neighborhoods move. Input, correspondence, connectivity and completed rod-prism frames stay fixed; every step checks reference tets, native prism/pyramid Jacobians and native shape quality. Zero disables this stage.

thickness_smoothing_iterations.description: Optional final coupled offset smoothing rounds, in [0,200]. Fits shell normal offset distance and rod section radius/plane while improving native prism AMIPS. Neighboring free rod offsets may move together. Input and protected offset vertices, correspondence and connectivity stay fixed. Tets and pyramids supply positivity constraints only; their shape quality is not optimized. Zero disables this stage.

jacobian_target.description: Positive target det(J), normalized by twice input triangle area times initial mean column length.

jacobian_position_weight.description: Positive quadratic weight on displacement from the position before Jacobian smoothing, normalized by target thickness (initial column length if unavailable).

jacobian_max_step_ratio.description: Positive per-move displacement bound relative to thickness. Implemented with an inscribed axis-aligned box.

jacobian_max_displacement_ratio.description: Positive total displacement bound from the position before Jacobian smoothing, relative to thickness. Implemented with an inscribed axis-aligned box.

background_remeshing.description: Enable adaptive background 2-3/3-2 swaps and interior relaxation after each tet iteration, then retry collapse. Requires keep_background_mesh=true. Input/offset vertices and exterior boundary are fixed during remeshing.

background_remeshing_passes.description: Local remeshing passes per tet iteration; positive.

background_quality_threshold.description: Trigger on background mean ratio below this threshold in (0,1]; 1 is a regular tet, 0 is degenerate. Background-blocked collapses are also repair targets.

background_remeshing_max_operations.description: Maximum accepted background swaps/moves per tet iteration; positive.

background_remeshing_max_attempts.description: Maximum attempted background swaps/moves per tet iteration; positive.

quality_improvement.description: Enable post-build region remeshing and native AMIPS-plus-thickness smoothing. Requires prism_dominant and a positive target thickness; rod frames are not supported. Replaces the separate Jacobian/background quality stages and transition/thickness smoothing. False disables this postprocess; there is no legacy relocation fallback. Nonzero min_tet_volume or relative_tet_volume_floor are rejected: this stage enforces strict positivity of actual cells.

quality_improvement_options.description: Options for quality_improvement. Final output selects the valid stage with the lowest global maximum AMIPS, independently of thickness energy; the target is not guaranteed within finite budgets. Non-box exterior domains retain fixed source triangulation, including offset boundaries if background was removed.

cycles.description: Maximum outer cycles, in [0,100]. Each has mixed smoothing, native/surface operations, bulk tet remeshing and mixed smoothing. Subsequent cycles halve sizing in one-ring neighborhoods of mixed cells above quality_target.

mixed_smoothing_sweeps.description: Maximum gradient smoothing sweeps per mixed stage, in [0,10000]. Active vertices come from actual mixed cells above quality_target; stop when no move is accepted or the target is reached.

volume_passes.description: Tet optimizer pass pairs per outer cycle, in [0,100]. Interfaces are fixed during this bulk stage.

column_collapse_attempts.description: Maximum paired prism-column collapse attempts per cycle; nonnegative.

surface_split_budget.description: Maximum conforming mixed surface/native split transactions per cycle; nonnegative.

surface_flip_attempts.description: Maximum compatible input/prism cap swaps per cycle; nonnegative.

volume_split_budget.description: Maximum generated interior tet split vertices per bulk stage; nonnegative. Unrepresentable floating-point midpoints are rejected.

time_limit.description: Positive soft time limit in seconds, checked between operations. Validation and export may extend beyond it.

initial_sizing_factor.description: Positive multiplier of the initial mean unique offset-face edge length. The target length and adaptive refinement floor are clamped to the nominal thickness.

quality_target.description: Raw native AMIPS stopping/activation threshold, finite and greater than 3; ideal=3. Covers all actual tet/prism/pyramid cells including input volume and background.

smoothing_target.description: Threshold of the squared excess AMIPS loss; at least 3 and strictly below quality_target. The loss includes a small log-AMIPS regularizer.

thickness_weight.description: Nonnegative weight on squared relative projection-height error along the original reference direction. No spatial thickness regularizer. The projection band is max(25%, current error).

topology_enabled.description: Enable native/surface and bulk tetrahedral topology operations; false runs the mixed smoothing stages alone.
